bracketing_true_rows.definition: semantics-only test on the true supported rows: lower = J(true rows + terminate), upper = J(true rows + mean rule), truth = J(true system); policies = all non-reference policies of every draw; violating = P(any unsupported decision) > 1e-12 on bench_mean; tolerance 1e-09; oracle cell: benchmark rows are the true rows; exceedance = J_true - upper when the upper bound fails; *_over_p_range divides by p_true (v_max - v_min) (Theorem part iii/iv bound)

bracketing_benchmark.definition: benchmark-level test (completion plus estimation error): J_true in [J_bench_terminate, J_bench_mean]; same policies, violating flag and tolerance as bracketing_true_rows

certified_comparisons.definition: default (non-reference) policies of each draw; certified ordered pair (i, j): lower(i) > upper(j) + 1e-09, lower = terminate-type and upper = mean-type value on the same targets (true_rows_* for the semantics-only test, bench_* for the benchmark test); at most one direction of a pair can be certified, so certified_share = certified / unordered pairs; certification error = certified but J_true(i) <= J_true(j) + tol (reversal = J_true(i) < J_true(j) - tol); point claims under one rule: J_rule(i) > J_rule(j) + tol, scored the same way; rule_dependent = pairs whose order flips between the two rules; counts pooled over draws

icu_intervals.definition: Part I (exact_results_all.csv, groups main + reference): per policy the identified interval [J_term, J_mean] on the released ICU-Sepsis rows, seed means; width = J_mean - J_term; p_any = mean-rule P(any unsupported decision), seed mean; admissible = p_any = 0 in every seed (width 0 <=> admissible verified)
